Fields: {"bio":{"biokeycheck":"An enum (BioKeywordMatch_enum) flagging suspicious or notable keywords (Suspicious, Normal, Spam, Promo).","biolang":"An enum (BioLanguage_enum) for the bio’s language code (en, multiple, mixed, unknown).","biolinknum":"An enum (BioLinkCount_enum) for the number of links (0 through 5).","biospan":"A SMALLINT measuring bio length in characters (e.g., '160')."},"completeness":"NUMERIC(3,2) reflecting how complete the profile is (e.g., '0.85').","contact":{"maildomainfmt":"An enum (EmailDomainType_enum) describing the email domain (Free, Unknown, Custom, Disposable).","phnumstate":"An enum (PhoneNumberStatus_enum) describing phone number status (Invalid, VOIP, Valid)."},"display_name":{"dispnameshift":"A SMALLINT counting how many times the display name changed (e.g., '3')."},"location":{"locgiven":"An enum (LocationProvided_enum) describing location provisioning (Fake, No, Yes, Multiple).","locshiftnum":"A SMALLINT showing how many times the stated location changed (e.g., '2')."},"picture":{"picformat":"An enum (ProfilePictureType_enum) describing the profile picture type (Stock, AI Generated, Real, Celebrity).","picscval":"NUMERIC(4,1) scoring the authenticity/quality of the picture (e.g., '7.5')."},"username":{"profnametag":"An enum (ProfileNamePattern_enum) describing the profile’s name style (Sequential, Template, Random, Natural).","usrentval":"NUMERIC(5,4) capturing username entropy (e.g., '0.2549').","usrlen":"A SMALLINT indicating how many characters are in the username (e.g., '12').","usrpatn":"An enum (UsernamePattern_enum) storing the username pattern (Random, Generated, Meaningful, AlphaNum)."}}
